About us

Imaginario is an NGO and a center for creative arts and educational innovation.

We use art as a space where people of all ages learn, express themselves and grow, with a special focus on children and young people.

Through carefully designed educational programs, artistic projects and inclusive practices, we build environments that encourage creativity, critical thinking and active participation.

Our work is grounded in contemporary cultural approaches, non-formal education and collaboration with the community.

Our studio

Imaginarium Art Studio

The hands-on side of Imaginario.

Imaginarium Art Studio is the art studio of Imaginario, in Bitola. It is where our approach to creative and non-formal education becomes everyday practice: drawing, painting and making things together.

We run art workshops and creative workshops for people of all ages, from children and young people to curious adults, and for companies and teams, in the studio and outdoors.

In just a few years, the studio has collaborated with the Municipality of Bitola and with teams from North Macedonia and abroad. It has taken part in a number of major events in Bitola and across the country, and worked with partners from Europe and beyond, so that more people can learn through art.
